baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَلِّغْ مَا أُنزِلَ ... فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُ
baseline_models.mechanism: A dispatched communication descends into the messenger's custody and must be carried all the way to its destination. Repeating ب ل غ across command and counterfactual makes endpoint arrival constitutive of the commission: an incomplete relay is treated as no relay.

activation_trace.role: Joins the commissioned carrier and the carried communication into one relay.
Supplies arrival at a limit and makes actual endpoint completion the test of the doubled verb.
Supplies caused downward delivery as the upstream movement that the messenger must continue.

changed_reading.before: State the revealed content to the audience.
changed_reading.after: Complete an entrusted relay so that what was sent down actually reaches its endpoint; withholding any part breaks the commission rather than merely diminishing it.

baseline_models.mechanism: The verse coordinates opposite motions: the communication is released outward while its carrier is held against interruption. Protection is therefore functional containment of the transmitting channel, not withdrawal of the messenger from human exposure.

activation_trace.role: Supplies release and outward dispatch as the motion that must remain open.
Supplies a preventing hold that preserves the carrier while transmission proceeds.
Locates the danger in the manifest human social field through which the relay must pass.

changed_reading.before: God keeps the messenger safe from people.
changed_reading.after: God holds the messenger-channel against human interruption so that the message, unlike its carrier, can be released fully into the human field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُ ... لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus distinguishes external arrival from internal orientation. The messenger is accountable for making the communication reach; gentle direction can still fail where a collective actively covers the truth, so hostile uptake is not the measure of completed conveyance.

activation_trace.role: Marks objective arrival at the communicative endpoint.
Supplies gentle orientation toward a path as a distinct reception process.
Supplies active obstruction of acknowledged truth as the barrier to guided uptake.
Makes the reception problem collective and social rather than merely private.

changed_reading.before: Successful delivery should be evidenced by the audience becoming guided.
changed_reading.after: Complete arrival and guided uptake are separate events: the first is demanded of the messenger even where collective truth-covering blocks the second.

context_deltas.mechanism: The destination is not passive: a public call can be appropriated into mockery and purposeless play, while an interior posture can be concealed behind a declaration. Complete conveyance must therefore remain publicly legible even when hearers recode or hide their response.

activation_trace.role: Keeps communicative arrival independently testable despite hostile audience transformations.
Supplies an openly raised call as the public transmission exposed to response.
Supplies appropriation, making ridicule an active capture of the call rather than mere inattention.
Converts the received call into derision and thereby changes its social presentation.
Removes serious purpose from the call and supplies a second mode of semantic interception.
Supplies concealment of the hearer's interior state, separating declared reception from actual uptake.

structural_cues: 5:57-58 repeat the taking of religion and the public call as mockery and play; 5:61 then contrasts a spoken claim of belief with what is hidden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a public call recoded as play and an interior condition concealed; I treat these as two interception mechanisms against which completed delivery must stay independently auditable. A live alternative is that both are only post-delivery reactions and do not affect the shape of conveyance itself.

changed_reading.before: Complete arrival is required even when uptake fails.
changed_reading.after: Complete arrival must remain unmistakable when hearers actively capture the call into ridicule or conceal their response; their recoding cannot redefine whether the messenger completed the relay.

context_deltas.mechanism: Learned office without restraining intervention becomes a countermodel for the messenger's commission. The focus conditional on not acting makes transmission an enacted responsibility: title, knowledge, and criticism are insufficient if they do not interrupt a harmful social production.

activation_trace.role: Makes omission the absence of an effect-producing act rather than a neutral pause.
Supplies the missing act of checking and restraining wrongdoing.
Locates the omission among holders of learned religious authority and sharpens the office-versus-action contrast.
Treats repeated wrongdoing as something socially produced, which responsible speech should interrupt.

structural_cues: 5:62 condemns what people do, 5:63 condemns learned authorities for not restraining what is said and consumed, and 5:67 defines the messenger's commission through the consequence of not acting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed learned restraint and the focus's action conditional; I infer an office-level contrast in which delivery is the messenger's required intervention. The alternative is that the rebuke of learned authorities and the messenger's command are adjacent but functionally independent.

changed_reading.before: Not conveying would leave an assigned communication unfinished.
changed_reading.after: Not conveying would reproduce the institutional failure just exposed: an office becomes empty when its holder does not actively interrupt concealment and harmful production.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus context materializes selective restraint through bound and extended hands, then recurring war-fires and their extinguishing. At the focus, the message is the element released, while divine holding prevents the human conflict field from closing the transmitting channel.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the outward release that protection must permit rather than restrain.
Supplies a fastening support by which the carrier remains secured under pressure.
Provides the concrete image of a limb-binding restraint and raises the question of what is wrongly or rightly held.
Provides the counter-motion of extending and releasing a hand, matching an unobstructed outgoing channel.
Supplies recurrent ignition as the conflict process threatening continuity of transmission.
Names the hostile field in which the protected relay must operate.
Supplies divine quenching as a contextual precedent for containing interruption without suppressing the message.

structural_cues: Within the pre-focus movement, 5:64 pairs bound and outspread hands and repeatedly ignited war with divine extinguishing before 5:67 pairs dispatch with protection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint/release imagery and divine quenching of recurrent conflict; I align those motions with the focus's released message and held messenger. The alternative is that the hand imagery concerns provision and the fire imagery communal war without specifying the mechanism of 5:67 protection.

changed_reading.before: Protection is a general preventing hold on harm.
changed_reading.after: Protection is selective conflict containment: it secures the carrier and quenches interruption while leaving the outgoing message fully extended and unbound.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is a hinge between recipient establishment and messenger transmission. The same descending material is at issue on both sides, but the verbs divide accountability: the messenger must make it reach, while recipients must stand it up as an operative order.

activation_trace.role: Defines the messenger-side responsibility as delivering the communication.
Supplies active rising to undertake an order as the recipient-side responsibility.
Identifies the established material as the same kind of caused delivery that enters the focus relay.
Repeats active undertaking after the focus and places the obligation in a collective social setting.
Repeats caused delivery on both the recipient and messenger sides, binding the flanking passages together.

structural_cues: 5:66 and 5:68 flank the focus with near-repetitions of what was sent down from their or your Lord, while establishment belongs to recipients and conveyance belongs to the messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated descent phrases and distinct obligation verbs; I infer a division of responsibility in which conveyance enables but does not substitute for establishment. A live alternative is that the repetition supplies topical emphasis without a formal sender-recipient division.

changed_reading.before: The messenger alone is charged with completing the movement of revelation.
changed_reading.after: The messenger is accountable for making revelation reach, while recipients are separately accountable for making it stand in practice; their failure cannot retroactively turn his completed relay into non-delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus envoy sequence establishes a recurrent hazard: commissioned carriers bring what selves resist and are denied or killed, while later messengers pass in succession. Protection in the focus therefore secures completion of this relay inside a known rejection pattern, rather than promising an opposition-free mission.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the preserving hold whose functional object is clarified by the later envoy hazard.
Places envoy sending inside an affirmed covenant rather than an optional communication.
Repeats dispatch across plural and singular carriers and turns the focus commission into one link in a sequence.
Supplies resistant self-inclination as the motive that opposes the arriving message.
Supplies denial as one recurrent response to the envoy chain.
Supplies lethal interruption as the extreme hazard against which protected completion becomes salient.
Returns to carrier and message language and normalizes the focus messenger within a succession.
Supplies the passing of earlier carriers, making continuity of the communication exceed any one messenger.

structural_cues: 5:70 replays sending and messenger language three times shortly after the focus and joins it to denial and killing; 5:75 again places one messenger among messengers who passed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a covenantal envoy chain, resistant desire, denial, killing, and succession; I infer that 5:67 protection guarantees completion within this pattern rather than absence of all opposition. The alternative is a broader personal safety promise whose relation to the chain is only thematic.

changed_reading.before: God prevents people from harming the messenger while he delivers.
changed_reading.after: God preserves this commissioned link long enough to complete the relay despite the established pattern of desire-driven denial and lethal interruption; protection serves continuity of mission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-guidance clause acquires a staged reception mechanism: inner sight is lost, hearing is stopped, disclosed signs are turned away from their orientation, and desire is followed into route-loss. Covering is thus enacted through sensory and volitional closure after indication is available.

activation_trace.role: Supplies gentle path-indication whose failure the later sequence decomposes.
Supplies covering as the common operation linking the later modes of closure.
Supplies loss of inner sight as one blocked input to guidance.
Supplies refusal or loss of hearing as a second blocked input.
Supplies reversal away from a disclosed orientation rather than lack of disclosure.
Supplies deliberate trailing behind a chosen leader of movement.
Identifies self-inclination as the substitute guide being followed.
Supplies repeated route-loss as the outcome of sensory closure and desire-led following.

structural_cues: 5:71 repeats blindness and deafness, 5:75 pairs displayed signs with being turned away, and 5:77 repeats straying around the command not to follow desires.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensory closure, reversal, following desire, and repeated route-loss; I infer a causal reception sequence behind the focus's non-guidance. A live alternative is that these are parallel consequences of covering rather than the mechanism by which guided uptake fails.

changed_reading.before: The truth-covering collective is not gently directed to the path.
changed_reading.after: Non-guidance is rendered as failed uptake after indication: inner sight and hearing close, signs are reversed, desire becomes the followed guide, and the route is repeatedly lost.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later tongue and mutual-restraint sequence turns conveyance into accountable speech-action. A tongue carries consequential communication, while failure to restrain a recognized wrong lets that wrong continue to be made; the focus's not-doing is therefore not neutral silence.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the delivery act whose bodily and social instrument is activated by the later tongue.
Explicitly makes the tongue an instrument for carrying a message and gives the focus command a bodily conduit.
Supplies departure from obedience as the condition to which consequential speech responds.
Supplies the omitted verbal intervention that should check an ongoing act.
Marks the act as recognizably reprehensible and properly subject to restraint.
Repeats effect-producing action around failed restraint and mirrors the focus conditional on not acting.

structural_cues: 5:78-79 directly sequence tongue, disobedience, failure to restrain, recognized wrong, and two occurrences of doing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a message-bearing tongue and a community that does not verbally restrain enacted wrong; I infer that commanded conveyance is a counter-action and that silence itself has effects. The alternative is that the tongue only identifies the historical vehicle of a curse and does not model the focus delivery.

changed_reading.before: The messenger must perform the assigned act of delivery.
changed_reading.after: Delivery is a consequential tongue-action that interrupts normalized wrong; refusing that speech is itself an operative failure, not an absence of action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human field from which the messenger is protected is sharply differentiated rather than uniformly hostile: it contains extreme enmity and near affection, followed by actual hearing, recognition, and testimony. Protection keeps the carrier present within this mixed field long enough for the relay to reach responsive hearers.

activation_trace.role: Supplies preservation within exposure, now refined by the later range of human responses.
Repeats the manifest human field and ties the later comparison directly to the focus threat-domain.
Supplies one pole of the field as active enmity.
Supplies nearness as the spatial relation opening the opposite reception pole.
Supplies affection as the social force opposite enmity within the same human field.
Turns acoustic reception into understanding and responsive compliance.
Places the commissioned carrier at the center of the demonstrated reception sequence.
Supplies recognition by a distinguishing trace, showing content that has genuinely registered.
Converts recognized knowledge into overt testimony and completes a successful uptake path.

structural_cues: 5:82 repeats people after the focus and pivots within one ayah from strongest enmity to nearest affection; 5:83 then stages revelation, messenger, hearing, recognition, and testimony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed human dispositions and a complete reception sequence; I infer that protection from people means secured operation within a differentiated social field, not separation from humanity. The alternative is that 5:82-83 simply identifies exceptional recipients without revising the scope of protection.

changed_reading.before: The messenger is held safe against a generally hostile human collective.
changed_reading.after: The messenger is preserved within a mixed human field so hostility cannot stop access to those who will hear, recognize, and testify; protection enables exposure rather than isolation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the packet's form-distant ر ب و target for ر ب ب with provision and liquid-flow images. It remains anchored to رَبِّكَ, أُنزِلَ, and بَلِّغْ and to the packet's descent, eating, overflowing, and river sequence; downstream prose should label it a material analogy for transmission and growth, not a lexical replacement for Lord or revelation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ... بَلِّغْ

activation_trace.role: The split target contributes feeding and growth as an exploratory source-image for the communication.
Starts the material analogy with a caused downward delivery.
Makes the descending material continue until it reaches a receiving endpoint.
Turns established descent into received provision within the exploratory growth model.
Supplies easy abundant overflow as the embodied result of receptive hearing.
Supplies a vessel filled past capacity, making reception visibly overflow through the eye.
Extends momentary overflow into continuing circulation.
Gives the continuing flow a channel that cuts through and reshapes its receiving ground.

changed_reading.before: The message is dispatched content that must reach its hearers.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, a nourishing descent is relayed to a receiver, taken in, overfills the eye, and continues through a durable channel: conveyance behaves like circulation that produces growth rather than a single utterance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ه د د target beneath ه د ي and places warning beside gentle direction. It remains anchored to the negated يَهْدِى and is sharpened by the nearby painful-punishment sequence; downstream prose must present it only as a split-root warning-shadow, never as the direct lexical sense of يَهْدِى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

activation_trace.role: Keeps gentle path-direction as the primary pole from which the outlier departs.
The split target supplies menace as an exploratory shadow at the point where direction is negated.
Supplies punitive pain as the nearby contextual realization of the warning-shadow.
Sharpens the warning as experienced hurt rather than mere lack of orientation.

changed_reading.before: God does not gently direct the truth-covering collective.
changed_reading.after: In a strictly contained split-root activation, refusal of gentle direction casts a warning-shadow: the unaccepted path tends toward menace and painful breakdown rather than remaining a neutral absence of guidance.

strongest_changes: The flanking 5:66 and 5:68 repetitions divide responsibility between messenger-side conveyance and recipient-side establishment.
The restraint, release, and fire imagery of 5:64 turns protection into preservation of an open transmitting channel amid recurring conflict.
The envoy sequence of 5:70-75 makes protection serve completion and continuity inside a known pattern of denial and lethal interruption.
The sensory and volitional sequence of 5:71-77 explains failed guidance as closed uptake after indication rather than failed external delivery.
The pivot from enmity to affection and then hearing, recognition, and testimony in 5:82-83 differentiates the human field and shows why protection enables exposure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus coordinates three non-equivalent operations: revelation descends, the messenger makes it reach, and recipients may or may not let it orient them. Context turns divine protection into selective holding of the carrier so the communication remains released through institutional silence, semantic capture, conflict, and uneven human reception.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet supports a mission-preservation reading of يَعْصِمُكَ, but does not settle how far that exhausts personal protection.
Mockery and concealment may be mechanisms that interfere with communicative arrival, or only hostile responses after arrival is already complete.
The nourishing-flow and guidance-warning readings depend on deliberately retained split-root or cross-domain activations and must remain exploratory.
